provenance.scene: Stock SwiftUI Menu("Menu selection") in a List Section (native reference app), iPadOS 27.0, light
provenance.device: iPad Pro 12.9 (6th gen), real HID taps via WDA
provenance.capture: Native ReplayKit recording in a native reference app with a 60 Hz refresh counter (3.31% skipped refreshes, max skip 1: fit-valid, not playback-valid)
provenance.method: Platter box per refresh (blurred frame difference against the closed frame, the label's text masked), timed by the counter. Open: two cycles, normalised from a point at the drop's first centre (Satin's plain drop grows from a point) to the settled panel; frames with at least 60% of the settled mask area, the 230-450 ms settle weighted 3x. Close: platter edges read per refresh from 60 Hz tiles (+-8 px), normalised from the panel to the drop that pours back into the label.
provenance.result: Open width reaches the panel at about 260 ms, overshoots about 0.9% near 290 ms and settles by about 420 ms (the previous contour, picker-glass-sheet at VFR, reached it at 200 ms with no settle). Close starts at once and eases out: 0.73 at 33 ms, 0.32 at 100 ms, 0.03 at 167 ms (the previous contour eased in).
provenance.centerY: The drop's vertical travel was 6 pt, below what a normalised fit resolves; centerY uses the width spring (one UIKit spring times the whole frame).
provenance.model: menuSpring.ts: displacement 1 -> 0, released after `delay` ms with `velocity` per second (negative moves toward the target), natural frequency `omega` (rad/s), damping ratio `zeta`.
provenance.units: ms; centerX, centerY, width, height normalised between the drop's seed (0) and the panel (1)
